content.thinking:
Interesting — much faster than I feared (0.03s for 2000 slices). Why? Because the chain `d_i = d_{i-1} + b"x"` merges lits: d_1 = Lit(b'abcdefghx') (merged into a single Lit since both items are Lits ≤ MERGE_LIMIT) → so the whole chain collapses to ONE Lit node ✓. Hence slices are O(1).

Let me build a chain that doesn't collapse: `d_i = d_{i-1} + b"x"*2` (a Rep node) → each level creates a Cat. Let me re-measure with that.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/project && timeout 600 python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys, time, resource; sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from modules import byte_program as bp
n=4000
defs = [('d0','b"x"*2')] + [('d%d'%i, 'd%d + b"x"*2'%(i-1)) for i in range(1,n)]
t=time.time(); ctx = bp.Context(defs,'s'); print('build %.2f'%(time.time()-t))
node = ctx.env['d%d'%(n-1)]
print('node type', type(node).__name__, 'kids', len(node.kids), 'len', node.n)
t=time.time()
for i in range(2000):
    ctx.expression('d%d[0:%d]' % (n-1, 1+(i%6)))
print('2000 distinct slices: %.2fs' % (time.time()-t))
t=time.time()
for i in range(200):
    ctx.expression('d%d[%d:%d]' % (n-1, i, i+3))
print('200 mid slices: %.2fs' % (time.time()-t))
print('maxrss MB', resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss/1024)
EOF
